mcqs.question: Cyclone Gezani, which struck Madagascar in February 2026, made landfall at which port city?
mcqs.explanation: Cyclone Gezani made landfall at the port city of Toamasina on Madagascar’s east coast. The east coast is the broader region, whereas Toamasina is the specific port city; 195 km/h refers to wind speed and 36 refers to reported deaths.
